Subdomain header allowlist entries must be valid HTTP header names

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig
from crawlberg import CrawlError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        engine_config = CrawlConfig(subdomain_header_allowlist=["invalid header name"])
        engine = create_engine(engine_config)
        url = "https://example.com"
        await scrape(engine, url)
    except CrawlError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
